raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Technical Project Manager | Dataflix Technologies Pvt. Ltd. | Jan 2022 - Dec 2025
Project 1: SCM, EDW, ASN, Logistics Automation, Container Count Automation
Client: Nextpower (formerly Nextracker)
Duration: Feb 2022 - Dec 2025
Role: Technical Project Manager
Description:
Led a large-scale digital transformation program for Nextracker focused on modernizing supply chain operations through the Anaplan platform across multiple business processes. The engagement included strategic initiatives involving the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Advanced Shipment Notification (ASN), Logistics and other enterprise transformation programs. As part of the managed services engagement, responsibilities included Anaplan platform operations, production support, incident management, system stability and continuous enhancement to ensure reliable business operations and ongoing process optimization.
Technical Project Manager Responsibilities:
Managed and owned end-to-end delivery of a program consisting of 4+ concurrent projects across Supply Chain (Anaplan), Enterprise Data Platforms, ASN, Logistics and Digital Transformation, overseeing scope, schedules, risks, dependencies, and production releases.
Led SCM (Anaplan) SaaS platform operations, ensuring stability, driving feature enhancements, and aligning with supply chain planning and operation needs, resulting in a 30% performance improvement. • Directed cross-functional teams (14+ members) across development, QA, data engineering, and business functions, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery aligned with business goals.
Designed and implemented end-to-end EDW pipelines using Azure Data Factory, enabling enterprise- wide data integration and analytics while owning and managing the client’s complete EDW ecosystem. • Ensured SLA adherence, issue resolution and quality standards by overseeing data pipelines, monitoring operational KPIs and aligning delivery outcomes with stakeholder expectations.
Scrum Master Responsibilities (Agile Delivery):
Facilitated Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Grooming, Sprint
Reviews and Retrospectives to ensure effective sprint execution and continuous improvement.
Acted as Scrum Master for cross-functional Agile teams delivering IT, SCM initiatives. • Partnered with Product Owners, Business Owners to refine and prioritize product backlogs, ensuring alignment with business priorities and roadmap objectives.
Proactively resolved team impediments and facilitated cross-functional collaboration, driving seamless
sprint execution and enhancing team productivity by ~20% through data-driven insights in Jira.
Technologies: Anaplan, ADF, Power BI, .Net, React, Python, SQL, MySQL, Jira
Project 2: Dealer Case Management, Big Data Platform
Client: Hyundai (HAEA, HACC)
Duration: Feb 2022 - Jan 2024
Role: Project Manager
Description:
Managed a digital transformation program for Hyundai (HAEA, HACC), driving DCM, Big Data, and chatbot initiatives while also overseeing managed services for platform operations, production support and incident management.
Responsibilities:
Owned end-to-end delivery of projects across DCM, Big Data, managing scope, schedules, risks,
dependencies and production releases.
Led cross-functional teams of 6+ members across development, data, and platform engineering,
ensuring on-time delivery aligned with business objectives.
Ensured SLA adherence, issue resolution and quality standards by aligning delivery outcomes with

stakeholder expectations. Implemented an AI chatbot using Dialog flow framework that reduced support tickets by 25%, enhancing process efficiency and improving customer experience.
Technologies: Big Data, .Net, SQL, React, Python, Restful APIs, Dialog Flow, NLP, ServiceNow
